title: operate_events inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the platform-operations fused-timeline tool (advertised name honua_operate_events). Read-only, paged: queries the unified Operate event timeline (mirror of GET /api/v1/admin/observability/events), which fuses alert, audit, job, release, sync-conflict, temporal, and log events into one normalized stream. Filter by event kind, correlation id, operation id, release id, and time range to trace a platform_release / server_upgrade or a long-running operation across sources. The response is a page of normalized events; see operate_events.result.schema.json. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

kind.description: Filter to one or more event categories (camelCase wire names).

correlationId.description: Filter to events carrying this cross-cutting correlation id (typically the request X-Correlation-ID).

operationId.description: Filter to events tied to this operation/job id.

releaseId.description: Filter to events tied to this platform_release / deploy release id (a Deploy operation's desiredRevision, or a metadata release's packageId).

from.description: Inclusive lower bound (ISO-8601) on the event occurrence time.

to.description: Exclusive upper bound (ISO-8601) on the event occurrence time.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of events to return in one page. The surface applies a server-defined default and maximum; an over-maximum request is clamped, not rejected.
